brief:
Manar Fattayer, an engineer and entrepreneur based in Ramallah, has embraced 3D printing technology to develop practical solutions for his community. Fattayer's interest in the technology began as curiosity before evolving into a business venture focused on turning innovative ideas into tangible products, according to Palestine News Network.

The engineer's work demonstrates how emerging manufacturing technologies can be adapted in the Palestinian territories to support local entrepreneurship and economic development. Fattayer's transition from following the technology abroad to implementing it locally reflects broader efforts to build sustainable industries in the West Bank.

title: Palestinian engineer uses 3D printing to transform local manufacturing
